Name: Sprinkler Attachments
Author: mushymato
Description:
[size=4][b]Seed Spreader
[/b][/size]
[size=3][u]Obtain from:[/u] Krobus on Sunday for 20000, Mr Qi's Walnut Room for 5 Qi Gems

Attach to a sprinkler and place seeds inside. The seeds will be planted overnight and sprout the next day.
[/size][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/25326/25326-1718844645-2033121759.png[/img]

[b][size=4]3-in-1 Nozzle

[/size][/b][size=3][u]Obtain from:[/u] Krobus on Sunday for 60000, Mr Qi's Walnut Room for 15 Qi Gems, or trade in other attachments.

Plants crops just like seed spreader, but also applies fertilizer and extends sprinkler range (like pressure nozzle).
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/25326/25326-1718844655-201355399.png[/img][/size]

(Attachments can be used on any sprinklers, not just iridium sprinkler)

[size=4][b]Configuration Options[/b]
[/size]
[u]Season Aware Planting[/u][size=3]: Prevent attachments from planting any crops that will wither before they can be harvested.[/size]

[u]Trellis Pattern[/u][size=3]: Control how non passable crops are planted, has 3 options: Any, Rows, Columns[/size]

[size=3][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/25326/25326-1718844409-1962405709.png[/img][/size]


[size=3][u]Restrict Krobus Stock[/u]: Disable this to let Krobus sell unlimited amount of sprinkler attachments (price unchanged).

[u]Invisible Attachments[/u]: Makes attachment invisible once attached to a sprinkler, for aesthetics.

[/size][size=3][u]Water On Planting[/u]: By default any crops planted by attachment will be watered, to ensure they grow.
[/size]
[size=3][u]Enable For Garden Pots:[/u] Allow attachment to plant seeds/apply fertilizer to garden pots. Note that sprinklers [b]DO NOT [/b]water the garden pots, since that functionality is better covered by mods such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21608]Garden Pot Options[/url].
[/size]
[size=3][u]Intake Chest Size[/u]: Control how many stacks of seed/fertilizer each attachment can hold.

[u]Open Intake Chest Key[/u]: Set which key opens an attachment's intake chest (default right click/controller A), chests can be opened remotely when using a mouse button.
[/size]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b]
[/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url][/size]
[*][size=3]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher﻿[/url], [/size]
[*][size=3](Optional but recommended) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ for in game mod configs.﻿[/size]
[*][size=3]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/size]
[*][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI[/size]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b]
[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Generally compatible with sprinklers mods that patch how the game determines sprinkler range.[/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17767]Better Sprinklers Plus[/url]: Compatibility included through that mod's API[/size]
[*][size=3]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23895]Line Sprinklers Redux[/url]: Plant seeds/fertilizer according to line sprinkler range, but does not draw the attachments correctly as that mod uses custom draw logic for line sprinklers. For now please use the "Invisible Attachments" option.[/size]
[*][size=3]Sprinkler activation mods [b]DO NOT[/b] trigger the planting of crops/fertilizer.[/size]
[/list]
